places.lead_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學健康科技學院副教授，台灣醫療救護學會秘書長。國立臺灣師範大學教育學博士（健康促進與衛生教育）、澳洲 Monash University 救護學學士，具 20 年新北市政府消防局救護技術員實務經驗，曾任亞東紀念醫院災難管理專員，負責全院緊急應變規劃、DMAT 建置與演訓。
places.lead_en: Associate Professor, College of Health Technology, National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Sciences, and Secretary-General of the Taiwan Society of Paramedicine. Doctorate in Education (Health Promotion and Health Education) from National Taiwan Normal University and a Bachelor of Emergency Health (Paramedic) from Monash University. Twenty years as an EMT with the New Taipei City Fire Department and four years as disaster management specialist at Far Eastern Memorial Hospital.

places.lead_zh: 主授健康科技學院碩士班流行病學方法論、進階應用統計學與韌性科技專題研討，並於國立臺灣師範大學以全英語講授安全教育。各課程均建置開放式互動教材網站，供學生與第一線人員自主學習。
places.lead_en: Teaches graduate courses in epidemiological methods, applied statistics and resilience technology at NTUNHS, and Safety Education in English at National Taiwan Normal University. Every course has an open interactive website for students and frontline clinicians.

places.lead_zh: 以行為科學與生物統計方法，探討救護人員職業傷害與心理健康、到院前臨床決策、創傷登錄品質及災難應變。著作清單每週自 ORCID 同步。
places.lead_en: Uses behavioural science and biostatistics to study occupational injury and mental health among EMS personnel, prehospital clinical decision-making, trauma registry quality and disaster response. Publications sync weekly from ORCID.

places.lead_zh: 將救護與災難應變之現場需求轉化為可驗證的科技方案，涵蓋智慧檢傷、沉浸式應變訓練與照護場域疏散系統。
places.lead_en: Turns field needs in EMS and disaster response into testable technology: smart triage, immersive response training and evacuation systems for care facilities.
